description: Roobet Crash Predictor Strategy Simulator 2026: Demo Round Testing Guide

paragraphs: Momentum Lens is a statistical observation studio built for people who enjoy studying demo rounds of multiplier-style games. Instead of chasing a mythical shortcut, Momentum Lens gives you a calm, glass-walled observatory where hundreds of simulated rounds can be replayed, compared, annotated, and turned into readable trends.
Think of it as a telescope for randomness — you are not bending the stars, you are learning how to watch them move.

The project began as an experiment: run a few hundred rounds in demo mode, compare the outcomes, and follow a simulation pipeline that highlights clusters, gaps, streaks, and cooldowns. Over time, the experiment grew into a full toolkit with a responsive interface, multilingual labels, and a community of curious analysts who simply love patterns.
features: 🧪 Simulation-first mindset — every insight is built on demo rounds, never live wagers.
📊 Comparison engine — stack hundreds of simulated sessions side by side.
🧩 Pattern annotations — mark streaks, freezes, and resets with your own notes.
🌍 Multilingual interface — comfortably usable across many locales.
📱 Responsive UI — phone, tablet, and desktop behave identically well.
